exposure: Clinical records of gestational age at birth
Antenatal ultrasound estimates of gestational age
ultrasound estimates derived from fetal biparietal diameter and femur length
antenatal estimates of gestational age by ultrasound
outcome: Agreement between antenatal ultrasound estimates of gestational age and clinical records at birth
Classification accuracy of preterm and postterm births
cohort: 578 pregnant women in the Brazilian Amazon
finding: While ultrasound provided the best estimate of gestational age in most cases, agreement with clinical records at birth was acceptable overall and good for preterm birth classification, but poor for postterm births.
mod_finding: Higher differences in gestational age were noted for caesarean deliveries, warranting further investigation.
gest_age: Gestational age was assessed antenatally and at birth.
